title: Flatten
story: Lists inside lists inside lists. Make one flat list.
goal: Write flatten(items): return a flat list of every non-list item, in order, however deeply nested.
hints: If an item is a list, flatten it too: that is recursion.
isinstance(item, list) tells you which case you are in.
socratic: What do you do with a list inside the list?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Flatten”?
